bifrost: none; drivers are in-kernel (springboard/src/bare/kms.rs, bluetooth.rs), apps are sandboxed by springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs
summary: Apple's user-space driver and system extension install and activation flow (OSSystemExtensionManager) is tied to macOS kernel policy and the notarized app bundle. BifrOSt has no equivalent install-and-approve path for user-space drivers; hardware drivers live in the Linux kernel and the shell talks to them directly.

features.note: Linux kernel modules are loaded by the system, not by apps; no user approval prompt exists

features.apple: System Extension Entitlement, System Extension Redistributable Entitlement
features.note: app sandbox is bubblewrap, not Apple entitlements
